title: User may lose funds if there are duplicate tokens in the deposit list
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  RelayerV2 doesn't check that token lists don't have duplicate items and doesn't support duplicate items in the list. If token lists have duplicate items then users may lose funds because some logics won't work as designed. For example when users set `_keepGovRights` as True, code loops through the tokens list and unstake all the RelayerV2 remaining balance, and it will cause the user to not receive the duplicate amounts.
